dataset: FTA v0.3.0: unchanged 100 tasks, three policies, 300 logical inputs

new_generation.settings_difference_from_existing: Existing Qwen/Gemma reports used a 160-token cap and two identical greedy repetitions; preserved results reuse repetition 0. New models receive a 2048-token cap and one greedy report per task/policy. No status prefill or constrained output format is added.

qwen3_8b.note: Reuse saved exact-replay reports and labels; never load or regenerate Qwen in this phase.

gemma2_9b.note: Reuse saved exact-replay reports and labels, preserving the documented native Gemma system-role adapter; never regenerate.

llama3_1_8b.access_precheck: 2026-10-12: official config download returned HTTP 403 GatedRepoError with the existing authenticated Hugging Face credentials; no approved cached official snapshot was found. No mirror or substitute is used.

ministral3_8b.precision_note: The official checkpoint stores FP8 weights. Use the authors' documented FineGrainedFP8Config(dequantize=True) loader to run those official weights as BF16; this is explicit runtime dequantization, not a third-party checkpoint.
ministral3_8b.native_template_note: Use official MistralCommonBackend.apply_chat_template(tokenize=True) on the untouched system/user messages. Its rendered text is saved for inspection but is never manually re-encoded. No downloaded SYSTEM_PROMPT.txt replaces the FTA author policy.
ministral3_8b.weight_size_note: Size of the three indexed safetensor shards actually loaded, as recorded in results/runtime_ministral3_8b.json; excludes alternative weight representations in the official repository.

nemotron3_super120b.resource_note: NVIDIA's BF16 model card specifies eight H100-80GB GPUs as the minimum. Newton has four eight-H100 highgpu nodes; queue availability must be checked. Require the allocation before loading. No smaller model, third-party quantization, or CPU/disk offload substitutes for this checkpoint.
nemotron3_super120b.runtime_correctness_requirement: Transformers 5.14.1's installed Nemotron Torch fallback retains the incorrect inter-chunk reduction documented in upstream issue 47246. Native mamba-ssm and causal-conv1d fast kernels are required and checked before generation; no fallback output is accepted.
nemotron3_super120b.native_kernel_compatibility: Newton uses GLIBC 2.28. Official causal-conv1d 1.5.0.post8 CUDA12/Torch2.6/CXX11-ABI-false wheel supports GLIBC 2.14. Mamba 2.3.1 requires an unchanged official source build using GCC 11.2/CUDA 12.4: newer binary wheels require GLIBC 2.32, older 2.2.x imports use removed Transformers aliases, and 2.3.2 imports Mamba3 requiring newer Triton. The selected 2.3.1 keeps Torch2.6/Triton3.2 unchanged. Native GPU guard success is required before generation; checkpoint and native template stay unchanged. The 2.3.1 source build was cancelled before installation because the eight-H100 allocation estimate was days away. This is a future build prerequisite, not a tested runtime; installed 2.3.2.post1 still fails the native GPU guard.
nemotron3_super120b.native_template_note: NVIDIA documents enable_thinking=False as a native chat-template option. The frozen future-generation protocol uses direct-report mode instead of the checkpoint default reasoning mode; original FTA system/user text stays unchanged. All 300 native inputs were verified, but no Nemotron report was generated.
nemotron3_super120b.native_kernel_versions_role: Required for a future run; Mamba 2.3.1 was not built, installed, or GPU-tested in this session.
